label: Low distress, low loneliness profile
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate education or above, with 1-3 hours as the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Low UCLA-8 loneliness score on average (0.79).
Low PHQ-9 depressive symptom level on average (0.28).
Very low GAD-7 anxiety symptom level on average (0.04).
Represents a training-split subgroup of 116 respondents.

label: Profile 1: Elevated loneliness, depression, and anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness along with elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms. Anxiety appears especially pronounced relative to the other reported indicators.
demographic_anchor: Primarily characterized by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and more than 5 hours in the referenced usage/time category.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 indicator
Shows elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Anxiety is the highest of the three mean symptom indicators

label: Lower distress, low loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms across the measured scales.
demographic_anchor: More commonly male, with graduate-level education or above, and reporting 1-3 hours in the referenced duration category.
behavior_markers: Low average loneliness score on UCLA-8
Low average depressive symptom score on PHQ-9
Low average anxiety symptom score on GAD-7
Overall pattern suggests relatively low psychological distress in this subgroup
